assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset: production 2D platform-game transparent terrain atlas. Image 1 is the geometry/layout template to re-skin; image 2 is ONLY the biome art/style reference, do not copy its large buildings or platform shapes. Swamp: drowned olive-black stone, twisting dark roots, hanging olive moss and sparse yellow-green firefly-like pinpoints. Match the mossy ruined swamp platforms in image 2. No purple or electric blue. Exactly four long separated horizontal strips in four equal-height rows: rows 1-2 are floor edges, plants above and stone below; rows 3-4 are ceiling edges, stone above and tiny hanging details below. Two different variants per direction. Keep each strip narrow. Flat continuous collision rim with organic fine detail. Entire strip from near left to near right edge, with clear empty space between rows. Hand-painted dark fantasy with detailed dimensional stone, matching the Mushroom Forest atlas's brushwork and scale. Preserve image 1 geometry and atlas composition. Small restrained glowing accents at exposed edges, near-black interior-facing material. No chunky protrusions, no scenery, no freestanding objects, no text, no labels, no grid lines. TRUE transparent alpha in all empty space, including between strips/sprites; no colored background or glow-filled backdrop. Sharp usable silhouette, no cast shadow outside sprite. Draw unique natural details for each variant.
